about.title: About the Ultra Prism set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Ultra Prism is a Sun & Moon expansion released on 2 February 2018. It has 173 cards: 156 in the main set and 17 secret rares. There are also 125 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 156 main set cards), the Master set (281 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 298 cards, adding the 17 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
